shortDescription.text: No Google Business Profile exists
No business hours on website or schema; GBP hours parity has no source
Live deployment canonicals to www.beatrox.com while serving on vercel.app host
Zero reviews on money pages; no acquisition program
Homepage H1 lacks the primary city
Homepage title lacks the primary city
Homepage body copy below 400 to 600 word money-page standard
46 services split across /services and /tech namespaces
Rendered titles duplicate the brand suffix
Deck images use generic alt text without local/service relevance
Em dashes render in live titles and metadata
/book renders without a canonical tag
Full LocalBusiness with address on every page plus redundant Organization entity
LocalBusiness missing geo, openingHours, @id, hasMap, image; areaServed unstructured
Schema offer catalog lists 8 of 46 services
Sitemap lastmod is one build timestamp for all URLs
schema/schema-beatrox-locbiz.jsonld is not served and drifts from live schema
Footer address renders without comma and with stray space
No Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Facebook, or BBB profiles
Site uses BEATROX and Beatrox LLC; intended GBP name Beatrox never appears in exact case

No reviews, ratings, client logos, or years-in-business adjacent to CTAs

No embedded Google Map on /contact or anywhere

message.text: No Google Business Profile exists for Beatrox. Local pack visibility is zero. Create and verify the profile per the GBP blueprint (name Beatrox, primary category Event management company, hybrid address display).

requiredState.gbp: claimed, video-verified, categories and services per gbp-blueprint.md

properties.fixInstructions: Manual client task. Verify domain in Search Console first for possible instant verification, then create the profile at business.google.com with the blueprint values. Prepare the video verification shot list before starting.
acceptanceCriteria: GBP NAP matches website NAP char-for-char
properties.verificationCommand: python3 /Users/lxrxcvi/.kimi-code/skills/elite-local-seo-audit/scripts/nap_parity.py --path site --name "Beatrox" --address "1313 SE 3rd Ave, Portland, OR 97214" --phone "(503) 515-4715"

message.text: Canonicals, sitemap locs, and robots Sitemap line all point to https://www.beatrox.com while the site serves on beatrox-website.vercel.app. If www.beatrox.com does not serve this deployment, GBP website URL and all canonical signals target a different or stale property.

requiredState.canonical: resolves to the same content on the final production domain

properties.fixInstructions: Decide the production domain, wire www.beatrox.com (and beatrox.com redirect) to this Vercel deployment, and confirm the old Squarespace property is fully replaced. Until then the GBP website link cannot be finalized.
acceptanceCriteria: curl -s https://www.beatrox.com returns the new H1
HTTP to HTTPS and apex to www redirects are single-hop 308s
properties.verificationCommand: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://www.beatrox.com && curl -s https://www.beatrox.com | grep -c 'Beatrox Experiential'

message.text: Homepage title carries no city. Apply the local title formula: primary keyword plus location plus brand, 60 chars or fewer.

requiredState.title: Event Production Company Portland, OR | BEATROX

properties.fixInstructions: Edit seo.title and og.title in both content/homepage.json (repo root, seed source) and site/content/homepage.json (runtime). Re-seed pages or edit the home doc in Payload admin so the CMS copy matches. Removes the em dash at the same time (P3-07).
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage title contains Portland and Event Production
No em dash in rendered title

message.text: Homepage H1 contains the service keyword but not the primary city (mandatory OP-17/OP-23 check). The H1 was fixed by client directive on 2026-08-07; the recommended fix appends the city while preserving that exact phrase.

properties.afterSnippet: "headline": "Beatrox Experiential and Event Production in Portland, OR"
properties.fixInstructions: Append 'in Portland, OR' to hero.headline in both homepage.json copies, site/components/HomeHero.tsx default, site/app/(site)/page.tsx IntroGate fallback, then re-seed the CMS home page. If the client declines, record an accepted deviation and cap P3 at 7.
acceptanceCriteria: H1 contains Event Production and Portland
Intro overlay match-frame verified visually at 375px and 1440px

message.text: Homepage body copy is ~338 words including template chrome, below the 400 to 600 word money-homepage standard (OP-23). Add one substantive section answering what, who, and why trust, with genuine Portland entities.

properties.fixInstructions: Add a homepage intro section (150 to 250 words) naming the Portland studio, the Central Eastside industrial district context, metro service area, and nationwide touring work. Human-first copy, no city-list block (OP-45).
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage body copy >= 400 words excluding nav/footer
3 or more genuine local entities present

message.text: Rendered titles duplicate the brand: 'Services — BEATROX | BEATROX'. The seo title already contains the brand and the metadata template appends ' | BEATROX' again.

requiredState.pattern: brand appears exactly once per title

properties.fixInstructions: In site/lib/metadata.ts seoToMetadata, do not append the brand template when the seo title already contains 'BEATROX' (case-insensitive). Alternatively strip ' — BEATROX' from the JSON seo titles. Pick one source of truth for the brand suffix.
acceptanceCriteria: No rendered title contains BEATROX twice

message.text: Footer address renders as '1313 SE 3rd Ave Portland , OR 97214' (missing comma after street, stray space before city comma). The GBP-matching exact string exists only on /contact.

properties.fixInstructions: Fix the footer component to render the address.formatted string from site/content/contact.json ('1313 SE 3rd Ave, Portland, OR 97214') verbatim instead of concatenating parts.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer address on homepage equals GBP address char-for-char

message.text: Intended GBP name 'Beatrox' never appears in exact case on the site; rendered name is 'BEATROX' (styling) and legal 'Beatrox LLC'. Schema name is 'BEATROX'. GBP-02 requires char-for-char parity between GBP name, website, and schema.

requiredState.note: visual all-caps styling via CSS is fine; underlying text and schema must read Beatrox

properties.fixInstructions: Set LocalBusiness and Organization schema name to 'Beatrox' (legalName may stay 'Beatrox LLC'). Keep visual brand lockup unchanged; ensure at least one crawlable instance of exact-case 'Beatrox' with the NAP (contact page company field already reads Beatrox LLC; add 'Beatrox' plain usage).
acceptanceCriteria: GBP name equals schema name char-for-char

message.text: /book renders with no canonical tag; its generateMetadata does not pass canonicalPath.

properties.afterSnippet: canonicalPath: '/book' passed through seoToMetadata (and em dash removed from title)
properties.fixInstructions: Route /book metadata through seoToMetadata with canonicalPath '/book' like other pages.

message.text: Full LocalBusiness (with street address) and a separate Organization entity are injected sitewide via layout.tsx. OP-08: only the homepage (and location pages) should carry full LocalBusiness; OP-07: do not duplicate the entity as a second type without a shared @id.

properties.afterSnippet: Homepage only: <JsonLd data={buildLocalBusinessSchema()} /> with stable @id; other pages: no business entity or a @id reference
properties.fixInstructions: Move the LocalBusiness JsonLd injection from the (site) layout into the homepage page component; drop the redundant Organization block (LocalBusiness inherits Organization). Give the entity a stable @id and reference that @id from Service schema providers.
acceptanceCriteria: No other page carries the full LocalBusiness block

message.text: LocalBusiness lacks geo, openingHours, @id, hasMap, and image; areaServed is the free-text string 'Portland, OR and worldwide' instead of structured entities.

properties.evidence: audit-evidence/homepage.html (full LocalBusiness block), schema/schema-beatrox-locbiz.jsonld:20-24 (geo coordinates available: 45.5134853, -122.6629198)
properties.fixInstructions: Extend buildLocalBusinessSchema in site/lib/schema.ts: add @id, geo (coords from the orphaned jsonld), hasMap (Google Maps share URL for the address), image, and structured areaServed listing the metro cities from intake. Add openingHoursSpecification only after the client confirms hours (blueprint proposes Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00).
acceptanceCriteria: geo, @id, hasMap present in homepage JSON-LD
areaServed structured and matches GBP service areas

message.text: Live offer catalog (and the orphaned jsonld) list 8 services; the site sells 46. GBP Services parity and AI grounding both need the full catalog.

properties.evidence: audit-evidence/homepage.html (LocalBusiness block), schema/schema-beatrox-locbiz.jsonld:99-168 (8 offers), audit-evidence/sitemap.xml (46 service URLs)

requiredState.note: each Offer links its /services or /tech URL

properties.fixInstructions: Generate hasOfferCatalog from the services content source (all 46 service JSONs) instead of a hardcoded 8-item list.
acceptanceCriteria: Offer catalog contains all 46 services with URLs

message.text: /rentals permanently redirects to app-ruby-pi-32.vercel.app, a separate deployment branding itself BEATROX LLC with its own self-canonical. The in-repo rentals landing page is dead code. Entity and link signals split across two hosts, and a throwaway vercel.app hostname leaks into nav on every page.

properties.evidence: audit-evidence/rentals.html (308 target, 4KB shell, BEATROX LLC branding), site/next.config redirects

requiredState.rentals: served on the primary domain (subdirectory or subdomain of beatrox.com)

properties.fixInstructions: Decision item for the client: move the rentals app to rentals.beatrox.com or beatrox.com/rentals (revive the in-repo page as the SEO landing page linking into the app). Do not leave a raw vercel.app host in production nav.
acceptanceCriteria: /rentals or nav rentals link resolves on a beatrox.com host
No vercel.app hostname in production nav

message.text: Contact form carries roughly 12 user-facing fields (name, email, company, location, event_type select, 12 service checkboxes, event_date, budget, message). OP-48 standard is 3 to 5 fields; each extra field costs 5 to 10 percent conversion.

requiredState.note: name, email, event/project type, message, plus optional phone

properties.fixInstructions: Trim consultationForm.fields in both content/contact.json copies to 5 fields; move services/budget/date qualifiers into the booking flow or a follow-up email. Confirm CRM mapping before dropping fields (they may feed Deals collections). Re-seed CMS contact doc after edit.
acceptanceCriteria: Rendered form has <= 5 visible fields plus honeypot/utm hiddens

message.text: No trust signal above the fold or adjacent to CTAs: no client names, review snippets, or years-in-business near the hero or the contact form (OP-46, OP-49).

requiredState.note: e.g. named-client line drawn from the real portfolio

properties.fixInstructions: Add a trust line under the hero CTAs using only verifiable portfolio clients (Super Bowl 2020, BuzzFeed, Adidas Run for the Oceans per existing work content). Add a second trust element adjacent to the contact form.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one trust signal visible in first viewport
Trust signal adjacent to contact form
All named clients verifiable in /work content

message.text: GA4 snippet is env-gated and NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is unset on the live deployment: zero googletagmanager references in served HTML. No conversion events, no thank-you tracking (OP-51, OP-63).

currentState.ga4: env var unset, snippet not rendered

requiredState.ga4: measurement ID set; form and booking submissions fire conversion events

properties.fixInstructions: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID (and the GA4 service-account vars for the admin dashboard) in the Vercel project for Production and Preview. Wire GA4 conversion events on contact submit and booking confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Test conversion event visible in GA4 Realtime

message.text: No embedded Google Map on /contact (OP-50). Map embed reinforces the geo signal and supports GBP website parity.

requiredState.note: keyless embed iframe for 1313 SE 3rd Ave, Portland, OR 97214

properties.fixInstructions: Add a keyless Google Maps embed iframe (maps.google.com/maps?q=<address>&output=embed) to the contact page near the NAP block. Lazy-load it.
acceptanceCriteria: contact.html contains a google maps embed iframe

message.text: No business hours on any page or in schema. GBP hours parity (GBP-12) requires a website source, and open-now is a pack ranking factor.

requiredState.hours: published on /contact and in schema; identical to GBP hours

properties.fixInstructions: Client confirms real hours (blueprint proposes Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00). Then add hours to contact.json, render on /contact, and add openingHoursSpecification to the LocalBusiness schema. All three surfaces must match GBP exactly.

message.text: Zero reviews or testimonials on money pages; no acquisition program. Reviews are 16 percent of pack weight and gate AI eligibility.

requiredState.onSiteReviews: named testimonials on homepage and top service pages

properties.fixInstructions: Manual: start the review ask program per the GBP blueprint (script included). Content: add named client testimonials to homepage and top 5 service pages once permission is secured. Never mark up self-serving AggregateRating on LocalBusiness (OP-10).
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials visible on homepage and top service pages

message.text: No core citations confirmed: Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Facebook, BBB. Citations are 13 percent of AI visibility weight; 3 or more NAP inconsistencies across sources is an AI-exclusion risk.

requiredState.coreCitations: Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Facebook, BBB, all with identical NAP

properties.fixInstructions: Manual client task: claim the five core citations with the exact GBP NAP (Beatrox, 1313 SE 3rd Ave, Portland, OR 97214, (503) 515-4715). Add LinkedIn and Clutch for the B2B vertical.

message.text: 46 services split across /services/* (15) and /tech/* (31); the /services index links only 15. The service mesh is fragmented (OP-24, OP-33, OP-34).

requiredState.note: either consolidate under /services with 301s, or cross-link both indexes bidirectionally with descriptive anchors

properties.fixInstructions: Decision item: consolidating /tech under /services is cleanest long-term but touches 31 URLs and their CMS docs. Minimum viable: link the full tech catalog from /services and vice versa.
acceptanceCriteria: Every service page reachable from /services within 2 clicks

message.text: Competitor GBP primary categories and review counts were captured via a search API, not live Google Maps. Verify top-3 category stacks manually before locking Beatrox categories (GC-20).

requiredState.competitorData: Maps view-source or GMBspy category stacks for MeyerPro, The AV Department, Pro Sound & Lighting

properties.fixInstructions: Manual: open each competitor's Maps listing, view-source, extract primary plus secondary categories (technique in gbp-categories.md section 1.5). Diff against the blueprint category set.

message.text: All 79 sitemap URLs share one build-timestamp lastmod, generated from new Date() at build time. Not a per-page freshness signal (OP-57, OP-70).

properties.evidence: audit-evidence/sitemap.xml (two distinct lastmod values across 79 URLs)

requiredState.lastmod: real per-content modified date, or omitted

properties.fixInstructions: Drop lastmod from sitemap entries until a real content-modified source exists (CMS updatedAt per doc is available via Payload).
acceptanceCriteria: lastmod omitted or reflects real content dates

message.text: Deck image alts are generic ('Aku World deck image 4'). Alt text should carry service and local relevance (OP-22).

properties.afterSnippet: alt="Aku World immersive environment build, Miami NFT activation"
properties.fixInstructions: Rewrite alt generation for deck/gallery images to use project name plus service plus location from existing project metadata. No stuffing.
acceptanceCriteria: No 'deck image N' alts on service and work pages

message.text: Em dashes render in live titles and metadata (Dash Law). content_lint.py output is noisy (1205 flags, mostly Tailwind classes and comments) but genuine prose instances exist in JSON seo blocks.

properties.fixInstructions: Replace em dashes with pipes or colons in all content JSON seo title/og fields and hardcoded page titles. Most instances get fixed as a side effect of P3-02 and P3-05.
acceptanceCriteria: No em dash in any rendered title or meta description

message.text: schema/schema-beatrox-locbiz.jsonld is orphaned (zero references) and drifts from the live schema (different name string, richer content). Either serve it or delete it; do not leave a stale parallel source of truth.

properties.evidence: repo grep: zero references to schema-beatrox-locbiz.jsonld

currentState.drift: name Beatrox LLC vs live BEATROX, 8 offers, has geo

requiredState.note: single source of truth in site/lib/schema.ts; harvest geo coords first

properties.fixInstructions: Harvest the geo coordinates into site/lib/schema.ts (P4-03), then delete the orphaned file on the remediation branch.

priorities.P0: ranking-critical, suspension-risk, or broken; blocks Elite

agentActionability.manual: client must act (photos, GBP clicks, review asks); goes on client task list

convention.closure: A finding closes only when every acceptanceCriterion is mechanically verified on re-audit.
convention.evidenceRule: Every result carries an evidence property citing a captured artifact path, plus beforeSnippet/afterSnippet for code and content findings.

properties.deploymentConstraint: All code/config/content remediation lands on a forked branch with a staged Vercel preview deployment only. The production deployment and production CMS are not touched without explicit approval.
